# Font Awesome Free 6.0.0-beta3 (self-hosted)

The portal's icons. Served from here instead of cdnjs.cloudflare.com so the
pages work without internet access from the client and no third party sees
each visit. `css/all.min.css` and `webfonts/` are the unmodified files from
https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.0.0-beta3/.

License (also in the header of all.min.css): icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1,
code MIT. https://fontawesome.com/license/free

Referenced from templates/base.html. To upgrade, replace both folders with the
same version's files; the CSS finds the fonts at ../webfonts/.
